title: 1 Hour Paddle Board Rental on Lake Austin Per Person
includes: Paddle Board, Paddle, Leash and Life Jacket
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Enjoy the best Paddle boarding that Austin has to offer. Stop by the must experience Mozarts Coffee and Roasters before/after embarking on an Paddle Board rental. We have an Artificial Turf Beach where you load into and out of the crystal clear Lake Austin. You'll be equipped with a life jacket, map of the lake and all proper safety instructions. Lake Austin is a very clean lake and the entire area you paddle board in is a No-Wake zone ensuring it to be calm and smooth for paddlers.
